reasons: The deviation is correctly identified: the p0030 grant runs to Licensee only, p0045 confines access to Licensee's employees, p0149 bars assignment without consent, and p0049 permits immediate termination for 'any breach' — squarely the walk-away posture (revocable at Licensor's discretion; affiliates/contractors excluded).

The redline reaches the playbook preferred position: grant extended to Affiliates and contractors acting on Licensee's behalf (bounded by Field of Use and confidentiality), successor transfer in an M&A event permitted, and Licensor's termination right narrowed to material breach uncured after 30 days' written notice. Direction favours the customer and nothing is conceded.

The 0.753 changed-character ratio on p0030 is acceptable here: a 'notwithstanding' override sentence is needed to neutralise the conflicting employee-only, no-sublicence and no-assignment restrictions elsewhere in the agreement without opening four additional paragraphs.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, cites the playbook rationale and offers the fallback (Affiliate coverage on written notice).

Minor clean-up to note, not fatal: p0049 retains the phrase 'In the event of such immediate termination' after 'immediately' was deleted from the preceding sentence — recommend changing to 'such termination' for internal consistency.

Also confirm that 'Affiliates' is a defined term in this agreement; it does not appear in the resolved definitions, so a short definition (or 'affiliates' lower case with a control-based description) may be needed to avoid an undefined capitalised term.
